richCategories.shortDescription: Help users understand electricity and gas bills, activate utilities, do voltura/subentro, switch provider, cancel contracts, complain about high bills, correct meter readings, request refunds, ask for installments, and escalate unresolved disputes to ARERA.
richCategories.mainUserQuestion: What utility problem do I have, and who should I contact: supplier, distributor, ARERA/Sportello Consumatore, Servizio Conciliazione, or emergency technical service?
richCategories.routingLogicSummary: For billing, contract, refund, switching, payment plan, unilateral changes, and contract-not-requested problems, contact the supplier first with a written complaint/request. For technical faults, meter danger, gas smell, power outage from the network, or urgent safety problems, contact the local distributor/pronto intervento number printed on the bill. For unresolved supplier complaints, route to ARERA/Sportello Consumatore and Servizio Conciliazione after the required complaint step.
richCategories.topWarning: Do not assume the supplier is Iren just because the user is in Torino. The app must ask the user to read the supplier and distributor names from the bill.

subcategories.title: Non-EU student in Torino
subcategories.whatIsIt: A non-EU student in Torino usually needs either private health insurance or voluntary SSN registration. If they want SSN access and a family doctor, they normally need to pay the annual contribution and present the request at ASL administrative offices.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Go in person to the ASL administrative office with the voluntary SSN registration forms and payment proof. Use PEC only for follow-up or rejected requests.
ASL administrative office of the Torino district where the student lives.

F24 payment receipt for voluntary SSN registration
